checks.scope: Indexed official registry and selected journal passages; original page access limitations noted. Sponsor is not necessarily funder; full version history, trial-level bias and integrity search unresolved.
checks.findings: Published Latch On report DOI 10.1111/1471-0528.17782 confirms registry. Irish multicentre RCT 225 randomized, primary outcome available 194; 3-month any breastfeeding 68/99 vs 59/95, adjusted OR 1.33 (0.72–2.46), p=.36. No clear effect. Control group sought more private support; self-selection, missing outcomes and disclosed deviations from planned clustering model limit interpretation. HSE regional nursing/midwifery unit partly funded staff time; authors state no design/analysis role, no conflicts declared; UCD and IReL administrative/open-access support. Registry sponsor field inaccessible. Support remains appropriate, no outcome guarantee.
